results.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2012-2015 Ford F-150 vehicles. The affected vehicles have side door latches that may experience a compromised pawl spring tab, resulting in a door that may not latch or may unlatch while driving.
results.Consequence: A door that unlatches while driving increases the risk of injury.
results.Remedy: Ford will notify owners, and dealers will replace the side door latches, free of charge.
results.Notes: Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 16S30.

results.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2013 Ford F-150 vehicles. Increased resistance in the driver's frontal air bag circuit may cause a delayed or non-deployment of the driver's frontal air bag in a crash.
results.Consequence: A delayed or non-deployment of the driver's frontal air bag increases the risk of injury in a crash.
results.Remedy: Ford will notify owners, and dealers will repair the affected circuit, free of charge.
results.Notes: Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.
